answer: Like a canyon narrowing the flow, require every new agent identity to stake collateral before transacting: each identity locks a meaningful bond for a full epoch tide, released only if its attestation history verifies. Every fake identity then costs real money, breaking the economics of sybil floods. A small set of publicly visible beacon verifiers, elected by stake weight rather than headcount, certifies which identities held up — honest agents cluster around the beacons while cheap fakes wash out with the tide.
